name: SIPOPO DATACENTER

name: National Tier IV / eight-submarine-cable data center initiative

name: Ministry of Finance Backup Data Center - Bata modernization
notes: Same modernization tender identifies the backup Finance Ministry data center in Bata, on the mainland Continental region; no MW capacity disclosed.
